serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Ah!{{punch}}
You: …
It was only a dream…
Good thing {f_botName} didn’t notice my distraught… 
Aside from that; something bad is happening to me. 
It’s not even the fault of the fish joint. I feel like something deep inside wants to break out and it scares me…

In my dream I think I saw… {{wi}}Who did I see again?
It’s so annoying! Not remembering a thing that just happened.
Well, it didn’t really happen... It was a dream, but still…
I can’t talk about it with anyone, they will probably just laugh at me or tell me to stop trying to improve using Mrs. Fisher’s method.
I really think I’m close to a major breakthrough! Stopping now would be…
But what if it’s more than a bad dream? Maybe I’m really starting to lose it…
Whatever it is, I need to take care of it. One way or another. Ignoring the signs is just asking for trouble.
I need to calm my mind more…
